mediaTypes.label: Screenshot
mediaTypes.description: A capture of a screen: the product, a page or a post.

mediaTypes.label: Infographic
mediaTypes.description: A chart, diagram or illustrated explanation.

mediaTypes.label: Thumbnail
mediaTypes.description: A small preview image, for example for a video or an article.

mediaTypes.label: Document
mediaTypes.description: A PDF, slide deck, spreadsheet or text file.

mediaTypes.label: Logo or brand
mediaTypes.description: Logos, icons, colours and other brand files.

mediaTypes.label: Other
mediaTypes.description: Anything that fits no other type.

feedbackTypes.label: User feedback
feedbackTypes.description: A general reaction, suggestion or observation from a user or a potential customer.

feedbackTypes.label: User interview
feedbackTypes.description: Notes from a conversation about someone's work, needs and the tools they use today.

feedbackTypes.label: Person to keep in touch with
feedbackTypes.description: Someone who matters to the startup: a regular user, an advocate, a partner contact or an advisor. Set a next contact date so the relationship does not go cold.

feedbackTypes.label: Testimonial
feedbackTypes.description: A quote or endorsement you may reuse with permission.

feedbackTypes.label: Case study
feedbackTypes.description: A fuller story of how someone used the product and what happened.

feedbackTypes.label: Feature request
feedbackTypes.description: A capability or change someone asked for.

feedbackTypes.label: Bug report
feedbackTypes.description: A problem that needs investigation or a fix.

feedbackTypes.label: Objection
feedbackTypes.description: A reason someone hesitated, stopped or chose something else.

feedbackTypes.label: Onboarding friction
feedbackTypes.description: Something that got in the way of signing up or getting started.

feedbackTypes.label: Activation
feedbackTypes.description: Someone's first real success with the product, or where they got stuck before it.

feedbackTypes.label: Retention or churn
feedbackTypes.description: Whether someone came back, used it less or left.

feedbackTypes.label: Usage outcome
feedbackTypes.description: What happened after someone used the product for a real task.

feedbackTypes.label: Proof point
feedbackTypes.description: Evidence that someone got value: a result, a number or a concrete outcome.

feedbackTypes.label: Support question
feedbackTypes.description: A question that shows confusion, a gap in the help pages or recurring support work.

feedbackTypes.label: Privacy or security concern
feedbackTypes.description: A worry about data, privacy, permissions or safety.

feedbackTypes.label: Partnership
feedbackTypes.description: A partner, integration, reseller or listing opportunity.

feedbackTypes.label: Competitor or market signal
feedbackTypes.description: A competitor, an alternative, a price change or a market shift worth watching.

feedbackTypes.label: Community signal
feedbackTypes.description: A pattern you notice in a community, forum or group.

feedbackTypes.label: Recommendation
feedbackTypes.description: Advice from a mentor, an advisor or your own review, kept until you act on it or drop it.

feedbackTypes.label: Assumption test
feedbackTypes.description: A belief the startup depends on, written so it can be proved wrong, with the evidence for and against it and a verdict.

feedbackStages.label: Discovery
feedbackStages.description: They are finding out the product exists.

feedbackStages.label: Evaluation
feedbackStages.description: They are comparing it with what they use today.

feedbackStages.label: Onboarding
feedbackStages.description: They are signing up or setting it up.

feedbackStages.label: First use
feedbackStages.description: They are trying it for the first time.

feedbackStages.label: Regular use
feedbackStages.description: They use it again and again.

feedbackStages.label: Purchase or renewal
feedbackStages.description: They are deciding to pay, or to keep paying.

feedbackEvidence.label: Tried it
feedbackEvidence.description: They used the product at least once.

feedbackEvidence.label: Completed a first task
feedbackEvidence.description: They got a real result with it.

feedbackEvidence.label: Repeated use
feedbackEvidence.description: They came back and used it again.

feedbackEvidence.label: Paid or agreed to pay
feedbackEvidence.description: Money changed hands, or they committed to it.

feedbackJourneySteps.label: Discovered
feedbackJourneySteps.description: They found out about the product.

feedbackJourneySteps.label: Signed up
feedbackJourneySteps.description: They created an account or installed it.

feedbackJourneySteps.label: Activated
feedbackJourneySteps.description: They got a first real result.
